presentation: Three observed issues, one guard-and-return task, one explicit layout tradeoff and a test that could disprove the hypothesis. Earlier explorations and review scores stay outside the main presentation.
third_pass: Historical pass: direct links, guard return, context scopes and retained nine-path navigation. Superseded presentation refinements are described in refinement.
source_consistency: PR overview groups secondary destinations; Continue is in More review tools; Diagrams is inside About layer; display controls sit above the code.
refinement: One shared navigation scroller, a dedicated file-action row, display controls above code, no unused old-line gutter for additions, and summary options after content.
hypothesis: Less searching and backtracking while preserving comprehension. Working interactions are not evidence of a usability improvement. Test explanation accuracy and wrong turns against the original.
readiness_corrections: Current layout supersedes the nested scrolling described in older reviews. Preserve navigation position and reveal the selected file only when needed.
compact_review_pass: Six full-row statement links; 64px range slot; secondary tools grouped; About links explains manual mapping; comparison includes the working access-check task. Paper updated first, then prototype and rationale.
return_state_repair: Return restores the captured caller anchor and keyboard line as well as position, even after revisiting the caller and changing its selection. Flow contract and exports updated October 23.
